title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Statement Glossary: Related Interest Base
content:
**Related interest base.** For a notice that a purchase processed in a foreign currency or outside the United States posted twice to a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the related interest base is the purchase interest charged on the latest statement when that statement charged purchase interest; when the latest statement charged only the minimum interest charge, the related interest base is that minimum interest charge; when the latest statement charged no interest, the related interest base is zero.

The latest statement is the account's most recent statement by statement date, and the interest it charged is the interest entries belonging to its billing period: purchase interest, or a minimum interest charge.

## By case

| Interest charged on the latest statement | Related interest base |
|---|---|
| purchase interest | that purchase interest |
| only the minimum interest charge | that minimum interest charge |
| no interest | zero |

## Examples (hypothetical statements)

- The latest statement charged USD 27.40 of purchase interest: the related interest base is USD 27.40.
- The latest statement charged only a USD 2.00 minimum interest charge: the related interest base is USD 2.00.
- The latest statement charged no interest because the grace period held: the related interest base is zero.
